violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition

EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO REMOVED THE Y SPLITTER AND ATTACH AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH INFORMATION FOR AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed Raw fish being stored on top of a box of avocados
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC ABOUT THE PROPER STORAGE ORDER OF RAW PROTEINS. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH PREVENTING CROSS CONTAMINATION POSTERS IN MULTIPLE LANGUAGES.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: Observed two large containers of Raw chicken on the food preparation table. EHS observed no staff processing the Raw chicken during the inspection. Raw chicken was observed at 46-49f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED RAW CHICKEN TO THE WALK IN COOLER TO COOL DOWN TO 41f. WHEN FOOD PREPARATION IS NOT BEING PREFORMED IMMEDIATELY, KEEP RAW CHICKEN AND OTHER TCS FOODS IN THE COOLERS. REMOVE FROM COOLER IMMEDIATELY BEFORE PROCESSING/WORKING.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: Observed no date marking system throughout the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO DATE MARK ALL FOODS THAT WILL BE STORED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH A DATE MARKING FACT SHEET.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed a spray bottle filled with a clear liquid being stored under a food preparation table.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC LABELED THE SPRAY BOTTLE AS “BLEACH”. LABEL ALL CHEMICAL BOTTLES

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Food Establishmend Prohibited from ROP of Fish
violations.observation: Observed Raw spicy salmon in vacuum packing in the walk in cooler. Upon discussion with staff and PIC, Raw fish is mixed with seasonings at the sushi bar and then vacuum packaged in house. Facility does not have a HACCP plan for Reduced Oxygen Packaging of Fish.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment may not package fresh fish (raw, unfrozen) using a ROP method. PIC REMOVED THE RAW FISH FROM THE VACUUM PACKAGING AND PLACE IT IN A ZIP TOP BAG.

violations.title: ROP, HACCP Plan in Place
violations.observation: The establishment does not have an approved HACCP plan for Raw beef steaks that is packaged using the Reduced Oxygen Packaging (ROP) process. EHS observed individually portioned vacuum packed Raw waygu beef steaks in the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment that packages a time/temperature control for safe food using a Reduced Oxygen Packaging method shall have a HACCP plan that contains the information specified under 8-201.14(D) and that: 1) identifies the food to be packaged, 2) requires that the packaged food shall be maintained at 41F or less, has a water activity of 0.91 or less, a pH of 4.6 or less, is a meat or poultry product that is cured at a food processing plant, is received in an intact package, or is a food with a high level of competing organisms, 3) describes how the package shall be prominently and conspicuosly labeled on the principal display panel in bold type on a contrasting background with instructions to maintain the food at 41F or below and discard the food if within 14 calendar days of its packaging, 40 limits the refrigerated shelf life to no more than 14 calendar days from packaging to consumption or the origjnal manufacturer's 'sell by' or 'use by' date whichever occurs first, 5) includes operational procedures that prohibit contacting food with bare hands, identifies a designated work area and the method by which physical barriers or methods of separation minimizes cross contamination, access to the processing equipment is limited to responsible trained personnel, and cleaning and sanitizing procedures for equipment/utensils is monitored, and 6) describes the training program that ensures that the individual responsible for the ROP operation understands the concepts required for a safe operation, understands the equipment and facilites, and procedures specified in this section. PIC REMOVED THE FROZEN STEAKS FROM THE VACUUM PACKAGING AND PLACED THE STEAKS IN ZIP TOP BAGS.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: Observed a container of egg fried rice wrapped in plastic cooling on a metal shelf in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS DISCUSSED WITH STAFF AND PIC TO COOL FOOD WITHOUT COVERING THE CONTAINER WITH PLASTIC TO ALLOW THE HEAT TO ESCAPE. SMALLER QUANTITIES OF FOOD MAY ALSO BE PLACED IN THE WALK IN REFRIGERATOR TO COOL WITHOUT NEEDING TO COOL OUTSIDE OF THE REFRIGERATOR.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed a box of frozen scallops being thawed on a shelf in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. STAFF PUT THE FROZEN SCALLOPS BACK IN THE WALK IN. THAW FROZEN FOOD IN COOLERS OR UNDER COLD, RUNNING WATER.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: Observed tampura sauce being stored in a coffee airpot dispenser with no label. Observed multiple large containers of various sauces being stored throughout the kitchen and coolers.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE LABEL ALL FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food being stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer. Observed a bag of onions being stored on the floor in the storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE ALL FOOD AND FOOD EQUIPMENT OFF OF THE FLOOR.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: rice scoops were observed being stored in a container of ambient water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC REMOVED THE CONTAINER OF UTENSILS TO BE WASHED AND SANITIZED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) left sushi display cooler
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PLEASE REPAIR COOLER. COOLERS WORK BEST WHEN SET BETWEEN 32f-38f.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: Observed three large, plastic, blue scoops with handles being stored in three different containers of sauces.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. STAFF REMOVED THE BLUE SCOOPS FROM THE SAUCES. USE NSF APPROVED UTENSILS FOR SCOOPING SAUCES.

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: Observed a home-use Ninja Air Fryer in the kitchen. Upon discussion with PIC, air fryer is used to steam buns for customers.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. REMOVE HOME-USE EQUIPMENT AND REPLACE WITH COMMERCIAL GRADE EQUIPMENT.
